items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1978-04-20
items.q: We had a junior school together. For kindergarten up. So that's where I attended.

ctx.x: For years of time, I'd hear that as a joke. They'd tune up and say good enough for jazz. They weren't concerned with things like that. Years ago, it was a whole different attitude. And of course, I think, here music still lives on New Orleans very much. As many people who applied about here could do that. Did you take lessons through the school or through a private teacher? Xavier. Xavier.

Xavier at that time. We had a junior school together. For kindergarten up. So that's where I attended. There was a 10-billton in the back. Even before that, the third floor of the front was called the 10-billton. So it was two months total there.
And what neighborhood were you from?
